fabricationFlags: INSTITUTION TYPE: This is a private Catholic HIGH SCHOOL (grades 9-12), not a university. Catalog presents grades as university-style 'programs' with programType:'degree' and a 4-year 'Full High School Program' framed like a degree track. High-school grades are not degrees.

PRICES STALE/WRONG: Catalog lists $13,300/yr for all grades. Official 2026-27 tuition is $15,300 (new students / non-Catholic returning) and $14,800 (returning Catholic). International listed at $14,500 in catalog is unverified. Catalog omits all mandatory fees the official page lists ($750 general fee, $550 non-refundable registration, $350 parent involvement, ~$500 books, $250 athletic participation, $250 mandatory fall fundraiser, etc.).

SCHOLARSHIP AMOUNTS FABRICATED: Official site lists only program names (Tuition Assistance, Catholic Education Foundation (CEF) Tuition Awards, 9th Grade Merit Scholarships) with NO published dollar amounts. Catalog invents specific figures ('up to $3,000', '$2,000', '$5,000', '$2,500'). 'Athletic Excellence Award' (44 teams) and 'International Student Scholarship via Amerigo' with stated amounts are not found on any official source and appear fabricated. 'Tuition Assistance Program (FACTS)' names FACTS as the assessment vendor — not verified on site.

ACCOMMODATION INVENTED: Official site only references Amerigo Education partnership for international students; it does not publish homestay/apartment housing options. Catalog's 'Independent homestay within 5 miles' and 'Private Apartment (South Bay)' options with specifics are not on the official source and appear fabricated.
SUMMER SCHOOL: $1,200 summer-school program fee and the program itself are unverifiable against the official site.
